column7: Decides that a retained single-call result whose target mints a per-caller credential is not served at admission but deferred until the caller's account is proven live (MIK-8392 STORED.2 site 1, E10)
Decides which targets need a liveness proof before a stored result is served: an account target or an identity-propagation backend (MIK-8392 STORED.2 E7); a false answer serves stored output unproven
Withholds a retained single-call result at admission unless its target needs no proof, recording it for the lift instead (MIK-8392 STORED.2 site 1)
Serves a deferred stored result only after this invocation's own resolution proved the account live, keyed to the invocation and taken once, keeping the nonce spent (MIK-8392 STORED.2 lift)
Proves a repeated task call's target live through the dispatch's own resolution step and answers its refusal or failed fill, never the stored output (MIK-8392 STORED.2 site 5)
Answers a repeated task call whose target is hidden only by a custody outage as the live call does (retryable), instead of serving or refusing it as missing (MIK-8392 STORED.2 E9)
Serves a repeated task call's stored task only when every recorded target proves live; the first refusal answers as the live call (MIK-8392 STORED.2 site 5)

Decides that a resolution proves the caller's account only when it minted a credential; an optional backend's static-credential fallback is no proof, so the stored per-user result is not served (MIK-8392 STORED.2 FIX 1)
